title: Meta Ads Underperforming? Do This First...
description: Meta Ads Underperforming? Do This First...
transcript: If your meta ads aren't performing, the first thing to take a look at is your offer. What are your prospects actually getting? What are you offering? This is not just going to be the product or service, but everything that's wrapped up in it. Are you offering a discount? A buy one get one free extra fast shipping? Free installation? A guarantee? Perhaps there's a reason why they need to buy now. It's because you've only got a few of these left. Or the special offer ends in a week's time or a few days time. Recrafting your offer and testing different offers is one of the highest leverage activities you can do as a meta advertiser. You can go from a campaign that completely won't perform to one that absolutely crushes with a much better offer.
